title: Personal Checking: which tiers pay interest and their APY bands
content:
## Scope

This rate sheet shows whether each Personal Checking tier pays interest and, for the interest-bearing tiers, the tiered annual percentage yield (APY) by end-of-day balance band. A band is identified by its floor in USD; the whole day's balance earns the APY of the highest floor it reaches.

## Interest-bearing status

| Tier | Pays interest | APY bands (band floor in USD: APY in percent) |
|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | No | 0.00 and above: 0.00% |
| Student Checking | No | 0.00 and above: 0.00% |
| Everyday Checking | No | 0.00 and above: 0.00% |
| Interest Checking | Yes | Bands listed in the next table |
| Premier Checking | Yes | Bands listed in the next table |
| Private Client Checking | Yes | Bands listed in the next table |

## APY bands of the interest-bearing tiers

| Band floor (USD) | Interest Checking APY | Premier Checking APY | Private Client Checking APY |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | 0.01% | 0.02% | 0.05% |
| 10000.00 | 0.02% | 0.05% | no band at this floor |
| 25000.00 | 0.05% | 0.10% | 0.15% |
| 100000.00 | 0.10% | 0.15% | 0.25% |
| 250000.00 | no band at this floor | no band at this floor | 0.35% |

## Reading a band (hypothetical balances, derived from the tables)

- **Whole balance, one rate.** A hypothetical Interest Checking end-of-day balance of 12000.00 USD reaches the 10000.00 floor but not the 25000.00 floor, so the whole 12000.00 earns 0.02%; the balance is not split between bands.
- **Exactly on a floor.** A hypothetical Premier Checking balance of exactly 25000.00 USD reaches the 25000.00 floor and earns 0.10%.
- **Private Client gap.** Private Client Checking has no 10000.00 floor, so a hypothetical balance of 20000.00 USD on that tier stays in the 0.00 band at 0.05%.
